title: Reports of 75 judges going to London for badminton event false and misleading: Centre to Delhi High Court
description: The Central government on Friday told the Delhi High Court that the social media posts and reports of over 75 judges and Union ministers travelling to London to participate in a Badminton event are "completely false and misleading".Solicitor General Tushar Mehta appeared for the government and argued that the photographs circulating on social media depicting Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant, Justice Vikram Nath and Union ministers Arjun Ram Meghwal and Kiren Rijiju playing badminton are f
